explore.summary: Discovered the existing m9-02 storage primitive bundle_events_or_legacy already had the v3 side-table shape needed; only the MCP surface was missing. R4 from m9-04 documented the explicit deferral. Service layer has only CounterexampleCounterexampleService::events_count (m8-05 B3); the m9-91 events accessor complements it.

spec.summary: 4 ADDED requirements pinning the wire envelope, pagination semantics, error path, and behaviour preservation. CounterexampleBundleEventsOutputDto with 4 fields; CounterexampleBundleEventsParams with 3 fields (limit + offset both optional).

tasks.summary: 5 reviewable work units: service method + DTO + MCP tool + verification + release. Single branch off main, 1 atomic conventional commit, ≤500 LoC forecast (well within budget).

disclosures.R1_m9_91_closes_m9_02_r4: counterexample_bundle_events MCP tool finally surfaces the m9-02 v3 side-table. m9-04 R4 explicitly deferred the tool to m9+; m9-91 closes that deferral.
disclosures.R2_m9_91_pagination_in_memory: Service loads events via bundle_events_or_legacy and applies offset/limit in memory. Limits are bounded by the persisted event count, not paginated at the storage level.
disclosures.R3_m9_91_trace_event_no_json_schema: JsonSchema derive skipped on the events Vec because TraceEvent doesn't implement JsonSchema. Wire format unchanged via serde; schema generation treats events as opaque. Pragmatic fix for a single cycle.
disclosures.R4_m9_91_no_chunk_iteration: Storage layout unchanged. The full events are loaded (m9-02 chokepoint) once; pagination is a slice on the in-memory Vec.
